prompt: wasm binary format name section placement ordering requirement
answer:
The WebAssembly **name section** is a custom section with the name string `"name"`. Its placement requirements are:

- It should appear **at most once** in a module.
- It should appear **only after the data section**.
- Since custom sections may generally occur anywhere, other custom sections may surround it; the ordering restriction specifically applies to the name section.
- Its subsections must each occur at most once and in **increasing subsection-ID order**: module name (0), function names (1), local names (2), type names (4), field names (10), and tag names (11).

The data section is the final non-custom section, so the name section follows all standard non-custom sections. (WebAssembly specification, [Custom Sections and Annotations](https://webassembly.github.io/spec/core/appendix/custom.html))
